prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent cutout scenery for an actual hybrid pixel-character / painterly 3D game, NOT a whole concept scene.
Use attached image only as reference for the mineralized living-continent world, muted taupe and mauve palette, and illustrated edge shapes. Create ONE isolated distant living buttress: a slender massive curved load-bearing root rising from lower left into an asymmetric swept fan of overlapping mineral shell plates toward upper right. Clear arched negative spaces between ribs; strong open silhouette; left base substantial but no wall across the canvas. A tapering irregular upper crown with only 3-4 main plates and sparse smaller chips. Underside has dense flexible slate-mauve lamellae and tension fibres, physically joined to hard chalky shells above; dry organic structures, no exposed flesh. Avoid a flat horizontal floating island/roof.
Medium: highly controlled hand-painted gouache game background, distinct contiguous colour shapes, thin broken warm edge strokes, resolved clear detailed silhouette and intentional clustered marks. Edges crisp at full resolution; no blurry brush smears, no depth of field, no baked fog or glow. Muted stone taupe, chalk grey, dusty mauve underplates, restrained pale ochre on upper edges. Broad lights and quiet interior shapes, limited tiny details. Upper left illumination consistent with reference; no strong shiny 3D specular.
Composition: full individual buttress visible, isolated with substantial genuine transparent space around it, image 1536x1024 landscape. The body sweeps diagonally from (20%,85%) to (80%,25%), with limbs and plates leaving at least half the canvas transparent. Nothing cropped; no ground plane, horizon, clouds, buildings, people, text, black outline, border, cast shadow on background or checkerboard. Genuine RGBA transparency, no halo.
processing: Original tool output copied without raster editing. Runtime texture filtering and material rendering only.
runtime: 2500x1667 world curved plane; original alpha 0..254; coverage narrowed with smoothstep(.72,.97) to remove source glow; linear mipmap sampling; root fixed, local tip displacement <=18.
